coverRows.label: Test Bench

coverRows.label: Release Gate

coverRows.value: Contents page (clickable TOC) immediately after cover.
Sections A, B, C: external references.
Sections D–L: tests. Record measurements in 'Measure' column.
Refresh fields: (Word: Ctrl+A → F9; LibreOffice: Tools→Update→Fields) - updates page numbers and TOC P/G.

knownIssues.heading: Known Issues — v1.2.0 Firmware
knownIssues.intro: Pytest xfail entries (expected fail) and corresponding DVT step pass criteria. Each row remains until fix releases and XPASSes (unexpected pass).

externalRefs.title: Main Board DVT
externalRefs.intro: PCB-level qualification of bare mainboard owned by external Main Board DVT. This document begins at assembled-controller boundary; bare-board electrical functional, HiPot, ICT, AOI not repeated here.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed Main Board DVT on record for mainboard serial number installed in this Fan Controller assembly. Signed copy attached to this run as artifact. Section B does not begin until Section A artifact is present.

externalRefs.title: MIB DVT
externalRefs.intro: PCB-level qualification of each MIB board owned by external MIB DVT. MIB-board electrical functional, AOI, and SPI-side functional testing owned by that document and not repeated here. This DVT begins MIB coverage at assembled-controller / FCAT-fixture boundary in Section F.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed MIB DVT on record for every MIB serial number installed in this Fan Controller assembly. Signed copies attached to this run as artifacts. Section D does not begin until all MIB DVT artifacts are present.

externalRefs.title: FCAT Test Report
externalRefs.intro: Basic functional and production+assembly verification owned by external FCAT bench (NI LabVIEW + SCPI). Proves production and assembly OK. This DVT begins coverage above and beyond basic FCAT checks. FCAT software reference attached separately (informational).
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed FCAT test report attached to this run as artifact. Section D does not begin until FCAT report present.

sections.name: Mechanical / Pre-energize Checks
sections.title: Section D — Mechanical / Pre-energize Checks
sections.intro: Run de-energized before mounting in FCAT. Catches assembled-unit defects or invalidates downstream measurements at first power-up. Above-and-beyond FCAT coverage of mechanical assembly (FCAT cannot torque, or visually inspect).

sections.name: Analog Voltage Testing (CN1, CN2)
sections.title: Section E — Analog Voltage Testing (CN1, CN2)
sections.intro: Analog voltage characterization on CN1/CN2 signal connectors. AI1 input, A1_OUTPUT, AIRFLOW_OUTPUT, DI thresholds, DO levels, K1 alarm relay, mainboard PT, accelerometer, EEPROM persistence. Includes out-of-bounds voltage stress and propagation-time captures via scope + logic analyzer. Power-supply behavior covered separately in Section G; comm protocols in H (BACnet) and I (Modbus); application logic in J.

sections.name: MIB-Side Behavior
sections.title: Section F — MIB-Side Behavior
sections.intro: Exercise MIBs as installed in UUT (fixed N per BoM). MIB enumeration and basic fan-enable / fan-status coverage handled by external FCAT (Section C); this section covers SPI bus integrity, PT linearity, and current-sense above-and-beyond FCAT scope. [mib.1.3] sustained SPI eye replaces former multi-N integration coverage; PCB-level MIB qualification owned by external MIB DVT (Section B).

sections.name: Power Supply Robustness (CN3)
sections.title: Section G — Power Supply Robustness (CN3)
sections.intro: Power supply behavior on CN3. [pwr_supply.0] baseline rails + monitors + input sweep + line frequency, [pwr_supply.1] CN3 over/under-voltage stress, [pwr_supply.2] power-up validation (console banner + first-valid Modbus/BACnet timing), [pwr_supply.3] operating-brownout response, [pwr_supply.4] cold-start brownout characterization (feeds dwell parameters), [pwr_supply.5] cold-start dwell sweeps, [pwr_supply.6] across-cycle checks. MPF DVT does not exercise variable-length power cycles — only place at any level.

sections.name: BACnet (BAC0 + YABE + MS/TP)
sections.title: Section H — BACnet (BAC0 + YABE + MS/TP)
sections.intro: BACnet coverage. [bacnet.0] = Ethernet network preamble + Who-Is sanity. [bacnet.1]–[bacnet.5] = automated BACnet/IP via Ethernet, driven by BAC0 (Python BACnet client, https://bac0.readthedocs.io/). [bacnet.6] = manual interactive BACnet/IP via YABE (Yet Another BACnet Explorer). [bacnet.7] = MS/TP over RS-485 — XFAIL on Rev 3 v1.2.0 (stack not yet shipped). [bacnet.8] = BACnet stress (high-rate polling, malformed frames). Object IDs reference published BACnet points list — see https://teamq-pac.atlassian.net/wiki/x/HYBB8Q. On Rev 3 v1.2.0, [bacnet.1.2]–[bacnet.5.1] and all [bacnet.7] rows are expected XFAIL per known_issues.cfg.

sections.name: Modbus + 24h Soak
sections.title: Section I — Modbus + 24h Soak
sections.intro: Modbus coverage plus 24h soak. [modbus.0] = baseline identity / echo / RS-485 termination via direct master. [modbus.1]–[modbus.2] = automated pytest-driven Modbus suite (identity reads, slave-ID change, internal temp, speed-mod and airflow round-trip, full point-list read, OOB alarm, alarm priority). [modbus.3] = Modbus stress (high-rate polling, malformed frames, multi-master). [modbus.4]–[modbus.5] = 24h soak under sustained polling. [modbus.6] = aggregate timing analysis. Soak catches drift-class defects single-shot tests miss.

sections.name: Business Logic
sections.title: Section J — Business Logic
sections.intro: Application/business-logic behavioral verification. Fan enable across cycles, blank-off (coil → DI mirror, alarm suppression), speed-mod variants (mode switching, transition response, airflow feedback loop), start/stop digital input (XFAIL — not yet shipped). Distinct from Section E (electrical/analog signal characterization) and Section F (MIB-side hardware behavior). Exercises control logic via Modbus and BACnet protocols (covered in H, I).

sections.name: Integration Cross-Checks
sections.title: Section K — Integration Cross-Checks
sections.intro: Cross-checks with MPF DVT under load. Run only after Section [mech]–[biz_logic] pass on bench and MPF DVT §3–§5 pass on system.

sections.name: Backward-Compatibility
sections.title: Section L — Backward-Compatibility
sections.intro: Qualify UUT firmware-and-mainboard against population of MIB revisions and firmware versions in field.

steps.brief: Inspect enclosure, panels, harness routing, controller mounting.
steps.criteria: No visible damage; panel screws at torque; PCB on 4 screws; tight

steps.brief: Torque each bus bar lug with calibrated wrench.
steps.criteria: All lugs at spec torque; clearance per drawing; no debris/corrosion

steps.brief: Verify fuse class, V, A match nameplate; no substitutions.
steps.criteria: All fuses match nameplate class/V/A

steps.brief: Tug-test CN1, CN2, CN3, CN4, CN5 and internal connectors.
steps.criteria: All seated; latches engaged (MIBs); tug-test holds

steps.brief: Inspect PT air tubes: routing, port mapping, fittings; leak test.
steps.criteria: No kinks; fittings tight; leak test at 20 inch.w.c.

steps.brief: Inspect labels for NRTL mark, required electrical information (FLA, supply voltage), etc.
steps.criteria: Labels applied; durable vs cleaning

steps.brief: Drive AI1 with calibrated 5.00 V ±1%; read firmware value.
Drive AI1 with 3 random voltages in 1–10 V at 1% precision.
steps.criteria: All 3 within ±2% applied

steps.brief: Drive AI1 shorted to AI1− and disconnected; record reported.
steps.criteria: Short: 0.00 V ±2% FS; Float: in documented floating region, not commanded speed

steps.brief: Set A1_OUTPUT to 3 random V in 1–5 V; measure at 5 mV.
steps.criteria: All 3 within ±4% commanded

steps.brief: Step DAC ±200 mV around 4.00 V; verify comparator transitions. Drift causes misapplied-AO behavior.
steps.criteria: Deterministic transition; no chatter; 4.00 V ±2%

steps.brief: Toggle selector between source 1 (4 V) and source 2 (1 V); confirm DAC follows. Stuck selector is in-circuit analog of misapplied-AO failure mode.
steps.criteria: Pos 1: 4 V ±4%; Pos 2: 1 V ±4%; toggle latency in spec

steps.brief: Read feedback ADC while sweeping DAC; compare at 3 points from E.2.1.
steps.criteria: Feedback within ±4% commanded each point

steps.brief: Set AIRFLOW_OUTPUT to 3 random V in 1–10 V; measure at 5 mV.
steps.criteria: All 3 within ±4% commanded

steps.brief: Sweep each DI 0.0–3.3 V in 0.05 V steps; record transition.
steps.criteria: HIGH ≥3.00 V; LOW ≤0.1 V; hysteresis in spec

steps.brief: Command each DO HIGH/LOW; measure no-load and 10 kΩ.
steps.criteria: HIGH > (3.3 V − 300 mV) both loads; LOW <0.1 V both

steps.brief: Cycle K1 50× via console; DMM K1A/K1B/K1C.
steps.criteria: 50 cycles transfer correctly; no misses; bounce in debounce window

steps.brief: Apply 0.0–10.0 inWc in 2.5 steps with calibrated pressure generator, 30 s dwell. Guards v1.2.0 PT type detection and SPI integration regression.
steps.criteria: Within transducer spec each step; monotonic; PT type detection reports expected vendor

steps.brief: Hold 5.0 inWc; sample at 10 Hz for 5 min; compute mean, std dev.
steps.criteria: Std dev in transducer noise spec; mean within ±1% of 5.0

steps.brief: Mainboard flat; read 3 axes via console.
steps.criteria: Each axis 970–1030 mg

steps.brief: Tilt 90° about X then Y; re-read. v1.2.0 added board-rev-dependent CS selection.
steps.criteria: Values match expected ±1 g within tilt accuracy

steps.brief: Write "test" to EEPROM scratch; power-cycle; re-read.
steps.criteria: Scratch reads "test" exactly; zero bit errors over 100-write/read burst

steps.brief: Drive AI1 to 12 V, 15 V (above 0–10 V spec) for 30 s each; verify clamp behavior and no permanent damage. Read firmware value at each step.
steps.criteria: Reported value clamps to documented saturation; no rail disturbance; AI1 returns to spec after stress

steps.brief: Drive AI1 to −2 V and −5 V for 30 s each; verify negative clamp.
steps.criteria: Reported value clamps to 0.00 V or documented negative floor; no damage; recovery clean

steps.brief: Command A1_OUTPUT to values below 0 V and above max via console; verify firmware clamps command, no damage.
steps.criteria: Commanded output clamps at documented limits; no DAC fault; recovery to commanded value clean

steps.brief: Inject 100 mV pk-pk noise on each DI line at 1 kHz; logic analyzer captures transitions.
steps.criteria: Zero false transitions over 60 s; firmware DI state stable

steps.brief: Load each DO with rated load and 1.5× rated load (resistive); measure drive integrity.
steps.criteria: HIGH/LOW levels within spec at both loads; no thermal warning; recovery clean after stress

steps.brief: Cycle K1 50× under representative alarm load; measure contact resistance and arc dwell.
steps.criteria: Resistance < spec each cycle; no welding; bounce in debounce window

steps.brief: Scope AI1 input step; LA captures firmware-read window via console-triggered GPIO. Measure stimulus-to-firmware-value latency.
steps.criteria: Latency ≤ documented sample period + 1 jitter slot; deterministic across 100 captures

steps.brief: Scope AO1 output after Modbus write completes (CRC ACK on bus). Measure command-to-output latency.
steps.criteria: Latency ≤ documented Modbus → DAC update spec; no glitch on AO1 during transition

steps.brief: Scope K1A/K1B contacts after coil write; LA captures driver line. Measure firmware-to-mechanical timing.
steps.criteria: Driver assertion ≤ firmware spec; K1 transfer time ≤ relay spec; no chatter

steps.brief: Scope SPI MISO at MIB position 1 and position N; LA captures CS. Measure clock-to-data delay across daisy chain.
steps.criteria: Setup/hold met at every position; aggregate propagation ≤ spec for configured N

steps.brief: Sweep SPI 100–640 kHz in 60 kHz steps; 1000-frame burst; capture eye.
steps.criteria: Zero bit errors each rate; clean eye at 640 kHz; setup/hold in spec

steps.brief: Repeat F.1.1 with 3.3 V at low-end tolerance.
steps.criteria: Zero bit errors each rate at 3.3 V = 3.1 V

steps.brief: Continuous SPI traffic at production rate for 10 min with all configured MIBs polling; capture eye at center and bracket extremes.
steps.criteria: Clean eye at all 3 points; zero corrupted frames over 10 min

steps.brief: Apply 0.0–10.0 inWc in 2.5 steps to MIB PT port; read via mainboard.
steps.criteria: Within transducer spec; monotonic

steps.brief: Repeat F.2.1 with each approved vendor in MIB BoM; compare vendor-to-vendor.
steps.criteria: Vendor agreement in cross-vendor tolerance every point; no vendor non-monotonic

steps.brief: Deferred — no programmable load on bench. Verify unloaded zero-current matches MCU telemetry; loaded shifts to MPF DVT.
steps.criteria: Unloaded zero current; no spurious fault; loaded marked deferred-to-system-DVT

steps.brief: DMM 3.3 V, 12 V, 24 V, V_RECT at idle, CN3=24 VDC.
Read rail-monitor ADC via console; compare to DMM. Drifted monitor was implicated in a prior cold-start regression — guard against recurrence.
steps.criteria: Each monitor within ±2% of DMM

steps.brief: Sweep CN3 22–26 VAC and 22–26 VDC in 1 V steps, 30 s dwell; log rails.
steps.criteria: Rails within G.0.1; no trip, brownout, comm drop

steps.brief: Sweep CN3 24 VAC 50–60 Hz in 2 Hz steps; verify firmware-reported frequency.
steps.criteria: Within ±2% applied each step

steps.brief: Ramp CN3 from 24 V down to 18 V in 0.5 V steps, 10 s dwell; log rails, Modbus, console.
steps.criteria: Rails track per spec until brownout threshold; clean reset below threshold; no garbled frames at transition

steps.brief: Ramp CN3 from 24 V up to 30 V in 0.5 V steps, 10 s dwell; verify operation, no rail damage.
steps.criteria: Rails within spec; no fault; recovery to nominal clean

steps.brief: Connect 3.3 V TTL UART; capture boot banner on power-up.
steps.criteria: Banner ≤2 s; IDN matches Test fw 2.0.0 string; zero framing/parity over 60 s

steps.brief: Issue rail, AI/AO setpoint, DAC, EEPROM commands; capture responses.
steps.criteria: All return expected; zero retries in 100-cmd sequence

steps.header: Power-up delay to first valid Modbus
steps.brief: CN3 OFF→ON; master polls identity register at 100 ms; record time from CN3 edge to first successful response.
steps.criteria: Power-up to first valid response ≤ firmware boot spec; no spurious responses pre-boot; identity correct

steps.header: Power-up delay to first valid BACnet
steps.brief: CN3 OFF→ON; BAC0 broadcasts Who-Is at 500 ms; record time to first I-Am.
steps.criteria: Power-up to first I-Am ≤ BACnet stack-init spec; device instance correct on first response

steps.brief: Active Modbus polling; sag CN3 from 24 V to 22 V for 100 ms; return to 24 V. Repeat 50 times.
steps.criteria: Zero resets; zero garbled frames; all 50 ride-throughs clean; rails stable post-dip

steps.brief: Active Modbus polling; sag CN3 to 16 V for 500 ms; recover.
steps.criteria: Clean reset on dip; no data corruption; EEPROM scratch intact post-recovery; boot banner clean

steps.brief: Sweep sag depth at 100 ms duration: 23, 22, 21, 20, 19, 18, 17 V. Identify ride-through floor.
steps.criteria: Boundary between ride-through and reset is repeatable ±0.5 V over 5 runs; matches firmware spec

steps.brief: Instrument 3.3/5/12/24 V rails and MCU NRST on scope at nominal CN3.
steps.criteria: All 4 ch at steady nominal; reset de-asserted; scope triggers reliably on rail-collapse threshold

steps.brief: Idle controller; CN3 OFF; record times to 3.3 V@80%, 50%, MCU reset assert, all rails zero.
steps.criteria: All 4 times recorded; reset asserts before any rail < MCU brownout threshold

steps.brief: Repeat G.4.2 with Modbus polling at 1 s production rate.
steps.criteria: Loaded times ≥ idle times by non-zero margin

steps.brief: Repeat G.4.2 at max-supported N (9 MIBs), motors unloaded. Loaded portion deferred — no programmable load on bench.
steps.criteria: All 4 times recorded at max-N unloaded; reset still leads any rail below threshold; loaded cell marked DEFERRED

steps.brief: CN3 ON from cold; capture rise; record CN3-ON to 3.3 V@90%, MCU reset de-assert, firmware banner.
steps.criteria: Three rise times; sequencing per firmware turn-on order; no overshoot; zero spurious console pre-banner

steps.brief: Compute G.5 dwell values from measurements (G.5.1=5×reset, G.5.2=1×zero, G.5.3=0.5×zero, G.5.4=0.1×zero). Re-derive on layout change.
steps.criteria: Four dwell values derived from real measurements before any sweep

steps.brief: 50 cycles at G.5.1 dwell (long, full collapse); ON dwell 60 s; verify banner, identity reads, atmospheric PT each cycle.
steps.criteria: All 50 boot clean; all 50 PT atmospheric; zero errors

steps.brief: 50 cycles at G.5.2 dwell (rails just reach zero); same per-cycle checks as G.5.1.
steps.criteria: All 50 boot clean; PT atmospheric; zero errors

steps.brief: 50 cycles at G.5.3 dwell (half-discharge, brownout window where prior regression lived); scope 1-in-5.
steps.criteria: All 50 boot clean; PT atmospheric; captures show no out-of-spec rail/reset; no out-of-range PT in first 1 s

steps.brief: 50 cycles at G.5.4 dwell (10% discharge, rails mostly energized); scope every 5th. Any deviation triggers CAR and blocks release.
steps.criteria: All 50 boot clean; zero out-of-range PT in first 1 s; zero errors

steps.brief: Master polls at 1 s during 20 G.5.3-class cycles; verify clean disconnect/reconnect.
steps.criteria: Clean disconnect/reconnect each cycle; zero garbled frames ±2 s of transition; zero stale-data accepts; ALARM_CODE 7 not triggered

steps.brief: Run pytest -k "TestBlackoutDetection" alongside cycles. Expects ALARM_CODE 1 on >30% sag below 16.8 V. XFAIL on v1.2.0 until detector ships.
steps.criteria: PASS (4/4) with detector enabled OR XFAIL per cfg; XPASS treated as anomaly

steps.brief: Connect Ethernet on 192.168.0.0/24; ping default IP; capture ARP.
steps.criteria: Link LED active; ARP succeeds with documented MAC; ICMP 0% loss over 100 packets

steps.brief: Disconnect Ethernet mid-run, reconnect; verify recovery. v1.2.0 brings new PHY driver.
steps.criteria: Recovers ≤5 s; no reset; no Modbus alarm; no missed frames

steps.brief: Quick stack-init sanity via BAC0 Who-Is broadcast. Full BACnet coverage below.
steps.criteria: I-Am received ≤5 s; device instance matches identity; no Modbus alarms/resets/poll impact

steps.brief: Start BAC0 instance on test PC; broadcast Who-Is over Ethernet; capture I-Am from UUT. Minimal connectivity sanity — applies to Rev 3 v1.2.0 (partial BACnet) and fw 1.4.0+ (full BACnet).
steps.criteria: I-Am received ≤5 s with documented device instance, BACnet address, vendor ID; no Modbus impact during broadcast

steps.brief: BAC0 reads device-name, vendor-identifier, model-name, firmware-revision, application-software-version. fw 1.4.0+ only — XFAIL on Rev 3 v1.2.0 (object read not yet implemented).
steps.criteria: All 5 objects return values matching identity sources (Modbus IRs, silkscreen); Rev 3 v1.2.0 marked XFAIL per known_issues

steps.header: BAC0 read AI1 voltage and airflow
steps.brief: BAC0 reads AI:0 (AI1 hardwired 0–10 V) and AV:1 (MPF Total Airflow, CFM) at 1 Hz for 60 s; cross-reference Modbus QFAN_AI1 and IR 8 (QFAN_AIRFLOW). fw 1.4.0+ only.
steps.criteria: AI:0 agrees with Modbus QFAN_AI1 within ±1%; AV:1 agrees with Modbus IR 8 within ±1% after unit conversion; zero exceptions; no Modbus poll impact

steps.brief: BAC0 writes AO:1 (MPF Speed Control, R/W) to 3 values in 0–10 V range with MI:0 (Control Source) = 2 (BACnet); verify Modbus mirror and physical UUT AO1 voltage. fw 1.4.0+ only.
steps.criteria: All 3 writes confirmed; AO:1 readback within ±0.05 V; Modbus mirror within ±1%; UUT AO1 DMM within ±4% commanded

steps.brief: BAC0 reads BI:0 (K1A), BI:1 (K1B), BI:2 (Start/Stop), and BV objects (Run Status, Fan Motor n Blank-Off, Fan Motor n Fault, Fan Motor n Enabled). Cross-reference Modbus DIs and coils. fw 1.4.0+ only.
steps.criteria: Every BI and BV matches corresponding Modbus DI/coil bit-for-bit; no spurious objects

steps.brief: BAC0 reads MI:0 (Control Source), MO:0 (Fan Status), MV:0 (Motor Count), MV:1 (Motors Enabled), MV:2 (Power State). fw 1.4.0+ only.
steps.criteria: Each multistate value matches firmware console; MV:2 reports Normal under nominal CN3

steps.brief: BAC0 subscribes to AI:0 with COV increment; force voltage change at AI1 input; verify COV notification. fw 1.4.0+ only.
steps.criteria: COV notification received ≤5 s of change; reported value matches stimulus within ±1%; unsubscribe clean

steps.brief: Run BAC0 reads at 1 Hz concurrent with Modbus polling at 1 s for 30 min; both interfaces active over Ethernet and RS-485 respectively. fw 1.4.0+ only.
steps.criteria: Both interfaces serve continuously; zero exceptions/timeouts; rails within G.0.1; no alarms; UUT not reset

steps.brief: Launch YABE on test PC; perform Who-Is; click UUT device; expand object list. Cross-reference enumerated objects against published points list (Confluence).
steps.criteria: All published objects present (AI:0; AO:0, AO:1; AV:0, AV:1; BI:0–2; BO:0, BO:1; BV:0 plus motor blank-off/fault/enabled; MI:0; MO:0; MV:0–2); no unpublished objects; on Rev 3 v1.2.0 only device-identification visible

steps.brief: Apply 5.00 V to AI1 input. In YABE, read AI:0 present-value.
steps.criteria: AI:0 reads 5.00 V ±2%; cross-check Modbus QFAN_AI1; YABE refreshes within 1 s. fw 1.4.0+ only.

steps.header: YABE switch Control Source to BACnet
steps.brief: In YABE, write MI:0 (Control Source) = 2 (BACnet). Confirm write succeeds.
steps.criteria: MI:0 readback = 2; firmware console confirms control source = BACnet; Modbus mirror updates. fw 1.4.0+ only.

steps.brief: With Control Source = BACnet (per H.6.3), write AO:1 (MPF Speed Control) to 7.50 V via YABE. Measure UUT AO1 with DMM; observe AV:1 (MPF Total Airflow).
steps.criteria: AO:1 readback = 7.50 V ±0.05; UUT AO1 DMM = 7.50 V ±4%; AV:1 matches Modbus IR 8 within ±1%. fw 1.4.0+ only.

steps.brief: With DI1 closed (Start), in YABE write BV:0 (Start/Stop) = FALSE. Observe Run Status and motor behavior. Restore BV:0 = TRUE.
steps.criteria: Motors stop on BV:0=FALSE; Run Status BV reflects; motors restart on BV:0=TRUE; matches BACnet override documentation. fw 1.4.0+ only.

steps.brief: In YABE, write Fan Motor 1 Blank-Off BV = TRUE. Observe MV:0 (Motor Count), MO:0 (Fan Status), Fan Motor 1 Fault BV, and alarm relay (BI:0/BI:1). Restore Blank-Off = FALSE.
steps.criteria: MV:0 decrements by 1; Fan Motor 1 Fault does NOT raise alarm (blank-off suppresses per documented behavior); BI:0/BI:1 do not transition; restore returns MV:0 and Fault state. fw 1.4.0+ only.

steps.brief: Trigger an alarm (disconnect a non-blanked motor). In YABE read BI:0 (K1A) and BI:1 (K1B); also MV:2 (Power State). Cross-check physical K1 contacts and Modbus alarm code.
steps.criteria: BI:0 (K1A) TRUE on fault (NC open); BI:1 (K1B) TRUE on fault (NO closed); MV:2 stays Normal unless brownout; physical K1 transitions; Modbus ALARM_CODE matches. fw 1.4.0+ only.

steps.brief: Reference PLC BACnet PICS PDF (Confluence). Spot-check 3 declared services via YABE: ReadPropertyMultiple, WritePropertyMultiple, COV-Notification. Confirm undeclared services return NotSupported.
steps.criteria: All 3 declared services respond per PICS; one undeclared service returns NotSupported. fw 1.4.0+ only.

steps.brief: Connect MS/TP master to UUT RS-485 BACnet port (separate from Modbus RS-485 if equipped, else shared per documented routing). Perform MS/TP Who-Is. XFAIL — MS/TP stack not implemented in v1.2.0 firmware.
steps.criteria: XFAIL accepted on Rev 3 v1.2.0 per known_issues.cfg. XPASS = MS/TP stack shipped — anomaly, reconcile against feature backlog

steps.brief: With MS/TP master configured, read AI:0 present-value over RS-485. XFAIL until MS/TP stack ships.

elaborations.text: PCB-level qualification of bare mainboard (HiPot, ICT, AOI, electrical functional at board boundary) owned by external Main Board DVT and not repeated here. Section A is a reference to that artifact and a placeholder for sign-off attestation that mainboard SN used in this assembly has a signed Main Board DVT on record.

PCB-level qualification of each MIB board owned by external MIB DVT. Section B is a reference and attestation page: for every MIB position in the assembly, a signed MIB DVT must be attached. Section F (MIB-Side Behavior) exercises MIBs as installed in FCAT fixture; does not duplicate bare-board coverage owned by Section B.

FCAT bench (NI LabVIEW + SCPI, pressure generator, mainboard + MIB-slot fixture) runs basic functional and production+assembly verification on every assembled controller. Proves production and assembly OK. Section C is a reference to that artifact and FCAT software description doc (informational). DVT begins above-and-beyond FCAT coverage in Section D.

Section D runs de-energized before mounting in FCAT. Catches assembled-unit defects that destroy hardware, injure personnel, or invalidate downstream measurements at first power-up. Covers mechanical/assembly items beyond FCAT scope: bus bar torque, harness inspection, tube routing.

Section E is pure analog/signal-electrical characterization on CN1/CN2. Out-of-bounds voltage stress (E.9), digital I/O stress (E.10), propagation time via scope + LA (E.11). Power-supply behavior moved to G; comm protocols to H (BACnet) and I (Modbus); application behavior to J. Boundary: if it's a signal voltage on a signal connector, it's E.

E.9.1–E.9.3 stress analog I/O beyond documented spec range. Verifies clamp behavior, no permanent damage, and clean recovery to nominal. AI/AO clamps. Distinct from FCAT linearity (which sweeps within-spec ranges only). CN3-side over/under-voltage stress lives in G.1.

E.11.1–E.11.4 use 4-channel scope + LA to measure end-to-end latency through firmware. Stimulus on scope channel + LA capture of firmware-side GPIO marker. Replaces purely-statistical timing inference with deterministic measurement. Critical for closed-loop control loop integrity.

Replaces multi-N MIB array SPI eye test from earlier doc revisions. Each Fan Controller assembly ships with fixed MIB count per BoM, so SPI eye exercised at that fixed N for production-rate-equivalent traffic rather than sweeping array sizes. Brownout characterization (G.4.4) still runs at max-supported N (9) because that's worst case for bulk-cap discharge regardless of any single unit's configuration.

Programmable electronic load is wish-list capital item (not on Q-PAC bench). Until acquired, loaded current-sense and max-power verification defers to system-level MPF DVT motor-side equivalent with motors connected. Bench-side reduced to unloaded sanity check.

Section G is CN3-side power-supply behavior. Baseline rails, input sweep, frequency. CN3 over/under-voltage stress. Power-up validation (console banner + first-valid Modbus and BACnet timing). Operating-brownout response (active polling during sag). Cold-start brownout characterization with dwell sweeps. Cold-start bus-buffer / PT regression on Rev2 passed individual desk testing because test setup did not exercise variable-length power cycles under realistic rail-collapse. G.4 outputs feed dwell parameters for G.5. MPF DVT does not exercise variable-length cycles — G is only place at any level.
Loaded N=9 brownout remains open gap until programmable load is on bench or covered at system level under MPF DVT equivalent. Data sheet cell marked DEFERRED — pgm load N/A.
On v1.2.0, blackout detection not yet shipped — detector not yet implemented in firmware. TestBlackoutDetection xfail until it lands.

H.0 covers network preamble (Ethernet link, recovery, Who-Is sanity). H.1–H.5 cover BACnet/IP via Ethernet, driven automated by BAC0 (https://bac0.readthedocs.io/): scripted reads/writes, COV subscription, concurrent-with-Modbus stress. H.6 covers BACnet/IP manual interactive via YABE (Yet Another BACnet Explorer, Windows GUI): object-tree browsing, point-by-point interactive write/read, PICS spot-check. H.7 covers MS/TP over RS-485 — XFAIL on Rev 3 v1.2.0 (stack not yet shipped). H.8 covers BACnet stress (high-rate polling, malformed APDUs). On Rev 3 v1.2.0 only H.0.3, H.1.1, and H.6.1 (Who-Is) are implemented; H.1.2–H.5.1, H.6.2–H.6.8, H.7, and H.8 are intentionally listed to track fw 1.4.0+ feature shipping and MS/TP enablement. Mark XFAIL via known_issues.cfg on Rev 3 runs; XPASS on Rev 3 means firmware shipped a feature early — anomaly worth flagging.

Authoritative object enumeration, IDs, descriptions, ranges, and Read/Write attributes: <Confluence Link>. UUT BACnet profile is B/AAC (Advanced Application Controller), server-only (no client), supporting COV, Notification, Schedule, BBMD, segmentation, time sync, ReadPropertyMultiple, WritePropertyMultiple. Update H.x.x criteria whenever points list adds, removes, or re-IDs an object.

BAC0 install: pip install BAC0. YABE install: download from current GitHub fork (was codeplex.com). MS/TP master: USB-to-RS485 adapter + BACnet MS/TP client (Cimetrics MS/TP or equivalent). Test PC needs network route to UUT BACnet/IP address (default 192.168.0.0/24 per H.0.1) and BACnet port 0xBAC0 (47808). For first run of each firmware build, capture pcap with Wireshark + bacnet dissector; attach to data sheet. UUT BACnet device instance and BACnet address recorded on cover.

YABE H.6 rows are sequential and depend on each other: H.6.1 (discovery) before H.6.2; H.6.3 (Control Source → BACnet) before H.6.4 (MPF Speed Control write — otherwise write is masked by AI1 hardwired source). Restore Control Source = 0 (AI1 default) at end of Section H.6 unless next test in Section H, I, or J specifies otherwise.

MS/TP coverage placeholder for fw 1.4.0+ enablement. v1.2.0 firmware does not include MS/TP driver — RS-485 stack is Modbus-only. H.7.1–H.7.4 marked XFAIL via known_issues.cfg. XPASS on Rev 3 = MS/TP shipped early; reconcile against feature backlog and update pass criteria with documented MS/TP routing (separate RS-485 port vs shared with Modbus).

Section I is Modbus protocol coverage plus 24h soak. I.0 = baseline direct-master sanity (identity, echo, termination). I.1–I.2 = pytest-driven Modbus suite (identity reads, slave-ID change, internal temp, speed-mod and airflow round-trip, full point-list, OOB alarm, alarm priority). I.3 = Modbus stress (high-rate polling, malformed frames, multi-master). I.4–I.5 = 24h soak. I.6 = aggregate timing analysis. Sustained polling catches drift-class defects single-shot tests miss.

I.1 and I.2 run from automated suite at C:\firmware\tools\. Default Modbus slave ID is 17 (field) and 19 (FCAT). Writing-key lockout for slave-ID writes documented in firmware; suite uses documented value — do not improvise.

On v1.2.0 this test is XFAIL via known_issues.cfg until write-side input validation is added. I.2.2 (ALARM_CODE=7 on invalid write) still PASSes because alarm-raising path is separate from write acceptance. If I.2.2 also fails, regression is beyond known issue and blocks release.
Per v1.2.0 release notes, Fan Controller → PLC Modbus RTU requires higher response timeout than legacy firmware; PLC 4.4.0 supports new timeout. Legacy timeout produces master-side false-positives.

Section J is application/business-logic behavioral verification — separate from electrical (E) and MIB hardware (F). Fan enable across cycles (J.1.1), blank-off behavior (J.2.1 coil-to-DI mirror, J.2.2 alarm suppression), speed-mod variants (J.3 mode switching, transition response, airflow feedback loop), start/stop DI XFAIL (J.4.1). Exercises features that depend on Modbus/BACnet protocols (H, I) being functional.
ECE-3164: Blank-off coil ON does not suppress that fan's alarm — fan alarm reads True (inverted). XFAIL via known_issues.cfg until fix lands. XPASS = ECE-3164 fix shipped, reconcile and remove XFAIL.

Start/Stop digital input is in feature backlog — not yet implemented in v1.2.0 firmware. J.4.1 placeholder marked XFAIL via known_issues.cfg. XPASS = feature shipped, reconcile against backlog and update pass criteria with hardware spec.
Per v1.2.0 release notes, Section K requires PLC firmware 4.4.0 on system side. Running against pre-4.4.0 PLC with v1.2.0 Fan Controller firmware produces Modbus timeout false-positives.
Mainboard Rev 2 has known bus-buffer cold-start defect; Section G required on every release. Mainboard Rev 1 out of warranty support; supports at most 4 MIBs with MIB Rev 2.

Appendix B is straw-man. Categories are starting point; Engineering to refine with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, System DVT owner before treated as authoritative. Cell entries conservative — when in doubt, table requires section.

Once HIL is tooled, severity 1 collapses to automated suite green on HIL plus short physical-sanity pass (G.2, I.0) when patch goes to production-released artifact rather than only engineering builds.

Production-line testing covered by FCMT2 Python at in-house Q-PAC bench with DHR logging (per spec ID 2026-02). PCB production test offloaded to electronics CM under per-board fee. DVT consumes some of the same fixtures but acceptance criteria are intentionally tighter and additive.

test_modbus_map.py (engineering/DVT) and FCMT2 (manufacturing production test) are distinct artifacts at different lifecycle stages. DVT runs on engineering builds and release candidates; FCMT2 runs on every production unit.

Suite supports known_issues.cfg — xfail when firmware bug is known and not release-blocking. XPASS (unexpected pass) surfaced in run report. Every DVT records known_issues.cfg version and reconciles every XPASS against open-defect tracker.
